entry.title: Celebrating My 10th Wedding Anniversary With a Twist ❤️| Nikhil surprised me 😍 #shortsfeed

media:group.media:title: Celebrating My 10th Wedding Anniversary With a Twist ❤️| Nikhil surprised me 😍 #shortsfeed
media:group.media:description:
This is a little story from our 10th wedding anniversary ❤️
We had planned a beautiful getaway — a spa day in Rishikesh, a surprise stay on floating huts in Tehri Lake, and one of the most peaceful mornings watching the sunrise together.
But here’s the truth…
We didn’t actually spend our anniversary day together.
While Nikhil was in Delhi, I was in Dehradun doing seva for an advanced meditation retreat. And even though it was a special milestone, we both chose something that felt more meaningful to us.
That’s the real secret behind our relationship — understanding, support, and choosing what truly matters.
Sharing this little piece of our journey with you 💙
#anniversary #anniversaryspecial #10anniversary #relationshipgoals #dateideas

What does it really mean to “behave like a woman”? This question has always fascinated me. Some things we do are celebrated, and some things are judged. But the truth is simple - every woman defines what being a woman means for herself.
In this video I’m sharing my experience attending a beautiful Women’s Day celebration hosted by BMW, where women from different fields came together to celebrate strength, individuality and authenticity. From wearing my mother-in-law’s saree and mogra gajra to driving the amazing BMW X1, the day was filled with wonderful conversations, inspiring women and of course some delicious food. To all the amazing women watching this may you always have the courage to be unapologetically yourself. Sending you lots of love 💛 Anita
